description:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS. We build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 250 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at massive scale, processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs spanning transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Data Engineer II to join our team. You will own data pipelines and analytical models within one or more data domains, improve the quality and accessibility of high-value datasets, and contribute to architectural improvements that support how AWS leaders make decisions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to clarify data requirements, implement data contracts and ingestion flows, and deliver scalable analytical datasets for customers across the organization.

The ideal candidate is an experienced data engineer who independently delivers reliable solutions to difficult data problems and seeks direction when broader architectural decisions require it. You have strong SQL, ETL, data modeling, and programming skills, with experience using cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lambda. Experience applying AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to data engineering use cases is valuable. You are comfortable working through loosely defined requirements, collaborating with technical and business partners, and building secure, maintainable data solutions at AWS scale.



Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and optimize logical data models and data pipelines for difficult datasets in the team's area. Translate loosely defined business requirements into secure, testable, maintainable, and efficient data solutions.
- Own the quality and operational health of assigned datasets and pipelines. Establish monitoring, alarming, runbooks, data validation, and SLA tracking, and participate in the team's on-call rotation.
- Contribute to data architecture and design decisions for the solutions you own. Apply established patterns and make sound trade-offs among delivery speed, scalability, maintainability, security, and cost.
- Build and operate infrastructure for assigned data solutions using automation and team standards. Anticipate access and processing needs, troubleshoot failures, and remove recurring operational bottlenecks.
- Partner with AWS service teams and analytics customers to clarify requirements, define data contracts, resolve data quality issues, and improve self-service access to trusted datasets.
- Own projects or substantial project components from design through launch and ongoing operations. Identify dependencies and risks, coordinate with peers and partner teams, and escalate when broader alignment or architectural guidance is needed.
- Apply data engineering best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, naming, dependency management, data certification, security, and auditability.
- Participate in code reviews and design discussions, provide constructive technical feedback, share knowledge, and begin mentoring less-experienced engineers.
- Identify limitations in existing data solutions and implement or propose improvements. Contribute to reusable patterns and larger architectural initiatives led by senior engineers.
- Explore and apply AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to improve data discovery, pipeline development, operational support, and analytics productivity.

ETL/ELT processes; (ii.) OLAP technologies; (iii.) data modeling; (iv.) SQL; and (v.) Oracle.
